title: Launch criteria + GA readiness checklist (Console guided onboarding checklist)
creator: Marissa Cole
project: Guided onboarding + first production launch checklist (Hosted API)
description:
Goal
Define the go/no-go criteria for moving the guided onboarding checklist from beta (flagged) to GA for Hosted API self-serve onboarding.

This ticket is the authoritative GA readiness checklist used at launch review. It consolidates requirements across:
- Telemetry event schema + pipeline health + dashboards (measurement must be trustworthy)
- UX quality bar + accessibility + performance
- Docs completeness + deep-link stability
- Support enablement + incident/rollback readiness

Scope
Phase 1: Hosted API onboarding checklist in Console + supporting docs/quickstarts + instrumentation.
Out of scope: Dedicated/Private onboarding GA criteria (tracked separately).

Owners
- PM (Hosted API): Nikhil Sharma
- PM (Console checklist): Marissa Cole
- Telemetry: Logan Wright / Nadia Rahman
- Console Eng: Dylan Brooks / Chloe Martin
- Docs: Elliot Price
- Support: Dev Patel
- Security/Privacy: Marcus Lin / Michael Grant

Definition of GA
GA = checklist UI enabled by default for eligible self-serve orgs (per rollout plan), supported by:
1) stable instrumentation + dashboards that accurately reflect completion funnel
2) docs/deep links aligned with steps and version-stable
3) support trained with macros/runbook + clear troubleshooting paths
4) operational controls: kill switch + rollback plan + monitoring/alerts

Launch review artifact checklist
- Final PRD signoff (Confluence)
- Final UX spec signoff (Confluence)
- Telemetry event schema v1 published (Confluence) + implementation conformant
- Beta retro reviewed + follow-ups triaged
- Release notes draft ready

GA readiness checklist (must-pass)
A) Product/UX quality bar
1. Step taxonomy + ordering is final and matches docs IA
   - Step names in Console match canonical doc headings (avoid drift)
   - Terminology consistent: org vs project, test key vs prod key
2. Step state behavior
   - State persists across sessions and devices for same org/project
   - Multi-project behavior is correct (steps that are per-project vs per-org clearly indicated)
   - Manual vs auto-validated steps clearly labeled; no “mystery completion”
   - Reset behavior works only via admin override tooling (no user self-reset in GA)
3. Validation UX
   - “First successful request” signal is robust and has clear timing expectations (e.g., up to X min)
   - “First streaming session” handles disconnect/retry edge cases without flapping
   - “Visited usage dashboard” tracking is privacy-safe and not noisy
4. Accessibility + i18n baseline
   - Keyboard navigation works for the checklist component
   - Screen reader labels present for step states (not just color)
   - Copy avoids overly long sentences; no truncation at standard widths
5. Performance/regression
   - Checklist component adds no material regression to Console page loads (agreed budget)
   - No high-frequency polling; step updates rely on events or bounded refresh
6. Feature flag UX
   - When flag is off, no dead links or broken routes
   - When flag is on, the checklist is discoverable but not blocking (no forced modal on first load unless explicitly approved)

B) Telemetry + measurement quality (SLOs)
Telemetry requirements exist to ensure we can trust onboarding funnel metrics and detect regressions quickly.

1. Event schema compliance
   - Only approved properties emitted (allowlist enforced)
   - No prompt content, no user text inputs, no request bodies recorded
   - Dedupe key present for idempotent events; retries don’t inflate counts
   - Identity model correct: org_id, project_id, user_id where available; respects anonymous-to-auth transitions

2. Pipeline SLOs (must be met for 7 consecutive days before GA default-on)
   - End-to-end delivery latency p95 <= 15 minutes (event emitted -> queryable dataset)
   - Missing event rate <= 0.5% per region per day for core events
   - Duplicate event rate <= 0.2% for core events
   - Regional parity: no region >2x missing rate of global median
   - Backfill behavior documented: if delays occur, dashboards show “data delayed” banner and do not mislead users

Core events (GA required)
- onboarding_checklist_viewed
- onboarding_step_viewed
- onboarding_step_completed (with step_id, completion_type=auto|manual)
- onboarding_validation_signal_observed (for auto steps; sampled if needed)
- onboarding_deeplink_clicked (step_id, destination)

3. Dashboards + alerting
   - Funnel dashboard built (signup -> key created -> first response -> production launch proxy) with cohort filters
   - Telemetry health dashboard built (ingestion lag, missing events by region, top errors)
   - Alerts configured:
     - missing core event >2% for 30 min in any region
     - ingestion lag p95 >30 min for 30 min
     - sudden step completion drop >30% WoW (after controlling for cohort size)

4. Privacy/security
   - Privacy review complete and tracked; any required implementation changes merged
   - Retention tags applied correctly (telemetry retention policy adhered to)
   - Access controls confirmed (who can query raw events vs aggregates)

C) Docs + quickstarts completeness
1. Canonical docs ready
   - “First request” docs updated and aligned with Console copy
   - “Streaming” docs updated; includes disconnect/retry guidance
   - “Structured output / tool calling basics” includes minimal example + failure modes
   - “First production launch” page published and linked from checklist

2. Deep-link correctness
   - All Console step CTAs deep link to version-stable URLs
   - UTM conventions implemented and validated (source=console, medium=onboarding, campaign=guided_checklist, content=step_id)
   - Redirect ownership confirmed (docs team) and tested for at least 2 previous URL variants

3. Troubleshooting coverage
   - 401: wrong environment key / missing header / expired key
   - 429: quota vs rate limits; backoff guidance
   - Timeouts: recommended timeouts and retry policy
   - Streaming disconnect: reconnection strategy + keepalive notes

4. SDK snippet parity
   - Python/TypeScript/Go snippets compile and produce identical behavior for:
     - auth
     - retries/backoff
     - streaming
     - request IDs for support correlation

D) Support enablement + operational readiness
1. Support training
   - 30-minute enablement delivered (recording + notes)
   - Support knows how to interpret checklist status and common failure modes

2. Macros + help center
   - Canned responses updated for top onboarding issues:
     - 401 wrong key environment
     - 429 rate limit/quota
     - streaming disconnect
   - Each macro links to the relevant troubleshooting doc + checklist step

3. Admin/support tooling
   - Admin override exists to reset checklist state for an org/project for troubleshooting
   - Audit log entry created when checklist state is reset (who/when/why)

4. Rollback and kill switch
   - Feature flag can be disabled globally and per-cohort within minutes
   - Runbook exists and has been dry-run once during beta
   - Post-rollback verification steps documented (telemetry impact, UI health)

E) Beta exit criteria (data-driven)
These are not “must-pass” individually, but are required inputs to the GA decision.
- Beta cohort size meets minimum for meaningful funnel reads (defined in PM-485)
- No P0/P1 onboarding-blocking bugs open
- Support ticket volume attributable to checklist <= baseline + agreed tolerance
- At least one iteration shipped based on beta feedback (e.g., reorder/simplify top drop-off step)

Open questions
1) What is the explicit GA default cohort? All new self-serve orgs vs staged percent rollout for all orgs.
2) What is the “production launch proxy” we’ll use as a measurable metric in Phase 1 (e.g., prod-mode API key created + >N requests/day + usage dashboard visit)?
3) Do we treat retries/timeouts as a standalone step or only as part of “First production launch”? (see ongoing discussion)

Proposed GA review meeting agenda
- Telemetry SLO report (last 7 days)
- Beta funnel snapshot + top drop-off steps
- Docs readiness signoff
- Support enablement signoff
- Rollout plan confirmation (flag defaults, monitoring, on-call owner)

Deliverable
A single yes/no GA recommendation with signoffs recorded in comments, plus any launch-blocking gaps converted into follow-up issues with owners/dates.
acceptance_criteria: GA checklist finalized and agreed by PM/Eng/Docs/Support/Telemetry
Telemetry pipeline meets agreed SLOs for 7 consecutive days pre-GA
Dashboards and alerts are live and owned (on-call rotation / escalation path documented)
Docs deep links are version-stable and UTM-tagged; redirects tested
Support macros + runbook published; enablement session completed
Feature flag kill switch and rollback steps validated in a dry run
All P0/P1 issues for onboarding checklist closed or explicitly waived with documented risk
comments: 2026-02-13 (Marissa Cole): Created this as the GA gate for console-2026.03. Please treat as must-pass list; if we disagree with an item, propose edits here and we’ll lock by end of next week.

2026-02-18 (Logan Wright): Telemetry SLOs look reasonable. Suggest tightening duplicate rate threshold to 0.2% for core events; we’ve seen 0.4–0.6% during retries when dedupe keys are missing. Also add explicit alert for ingestion lag p95 >30m.

2026-02-19 (Marcus Lin): Security note: ensure allowlist enforcement is server-side too (not only Console). Also confirm no query access to raw event properties for non-analytics staff; aggregated dashboard is fine.
2026-02-21 (Elliot Price): Docs deep-link requirement accepted. Please confirm final step IDs by 2/24 so we can lock URLs + anchors and avoid last-minute redirect churn.

2026-02-25 (Dev Patel): Support enablement request: include a one-page ‘How to read the checklist’ cheat sheet + where to find the admin reset tool. We can own the macros but need the final troubleshooting doc URLs.

2026-03-04 (Nikhil Sharma): Updated beta exit criteria section to reflect current discussion: production proxy likely = prod-mode key created + sustained usage. Still open on whether retries/timeouts becomes its own step vs bundled under production launch.
